description: This file contains the implementation of the WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing WebAudioPlayer IPC mechanisms, including creating, subscribing, and destroying IPC instances, as well as handling mock expectations.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing WebAudioPlayer IPC interactions.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and prepares the test environment.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects and resets the environment after tests.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates and initializes a WebAudioPlayerIpc instance, setting up expectations for IPC calls.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets up expectations for subscribing to WebAudioPlayer state events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets up expectations for unsubscribing from WebAudioPlayer state events.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destroys the WebAudioPlayerIpc instance and cleans up event subscriptions.

methods.name: setCreateWebAudioPlayerResponse
methods.description: Sets the web audio player handle in the create response message.
